title.zh: 逻辑斯蒂增长 · S 形曲线

description.zh: 没有天花板时种群按比例越长越快（指数增长）；环境最多养得起 K 个，于是实际增长率变成 r·(1 − N/K)，越接近 K 涨得越慢，曲线被压成 S 形，从上方超载也会回落到 K。
description.en: With no ceiling a population grows in proportion to its size — ever faster (exponential growth); the environment can support at most K, so the actual rate becomes r·(1 − N/K), slowing as N nears K and bending the curve into an S; a population that starts above K falls back to it.

aliases.zh: J 形增长和 S 形增长
种群为什么不会无限增长

label.zh: 没有 K 时就是指数增长
label.en: Without K it is exponential growth

reason.zh: N(t) = N₀·e^(rt) 是逻辑斯蒂曲线的起点：N 远小于 K 时两条线重合，翻倍时间是 ln2 / r；K 只是把这条指数线压弯。
reason.en: N(t) = N₀·e^(rt) is where the logistic curve starts: while N is far below K the two lines coincide and the doubling time is ln2 / r; K only bends that exponential.

label.zh: r 太大时离散模型走向混沌
label.en: Push r too far and the discrete model turns chaotic

reason.zh: 逐代迭代 N ← N + rN(1 − N/K) 在 r > 2 时不再趋稳：先 2 周期、4 周期，r 约 2.57 以后进入混沌，初值差一点结果就天差地别——和三体一样，确定规则也能不可预测。
reason.en: The generation-by-generation update N ← N + rN(1 − N/K) stops settling once r > 2: first period 2, then 4, and past r ≈ 2.57 it is chaotic, with tiny differences in the start blowing up — like the three-body problem, a deterministic rule that cannot be predicted.

label.zh: 在 K 的反馈旁边加一个捕食者
label.en: Add a predator next to the K feedback

reason.zh: 捕食者—猎物模型以猎物自己的逻辑斯蒂增长为底，再加上被吃掉的那一项；没有捕食者时，猎物就停在 K。
reason.en: The predator–prey model starts from the prey’s own logistic growth and adds a term for being eaten; with no predator the prey simply settles at K.

question.zh: 种群数量为什么会长成 S 形，而不是一直指数增长？
question.en: Why does a population grow in an S-shape instead of exponentially forever?

ask.zh: 每一代都按同一比例增长，曲线会怎样？
ask.en: If every generation grows by the same proportion, what does the curve do?

ask.zh: N 接近 K 时，r·(1 − N/K) 变成多少？
ask.en: As N approaches K, what does r·(1 − N/K) become?

reveal.zh: 开始时资源充足，增长接近指数；但实际增长率 r·(1 − N/K) 随数量逼近容纳量 K 而趋于 0，曲线被压平，于是成了 S 形。
reveal.en: At first resources are plentiful and growth is nearly exponential; but the actual rate r·(1 − N/K) shrinks towards 0 as the population nears the carrying capacity K, flattening the curve into an S.
